mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, r.day, e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, r.day, e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN branch b ON e.branch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN company c ON b.company_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{companyId}

SELECT r.id, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, r.day, e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN branch b ON e.branch_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{branchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO register (employee_id, start_of_the_day, entry, exit, break_time, back_to_work, day) VALUES (#{employee.id}, #{startOfTheDay}, #{entry}, #{exit}, #{breakTime}, #{backToWork}, #{day})

MERGE INTO register target USING ( SELECT #{register.employeeId} AS employee_id, SYSDATE AS current_date FROM dual ) source ON (target.employee_id = source.employee_id AND TRUNC(target.day) = TRUNC(source.current_date)) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.break_time = CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 2 THEN source.current_date ELSE target.break_time END, target.back_to_work = CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 3 THEN source.current_date ELSE target.back_to_work END, target.exit = CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 4 THEN source.current_date ELSE target.exit END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, employee_id, day, start_of_the_day, entry, exit, break_time, back_to_work) VALUES ( register_seq.NEXTVAL, | #{register.employeeId}, TRUNC(source.current_date), CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 1 THEN source.current_date ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 1 THEN source.current_date ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 4 THEN source.current_date ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 2 THEN source.current_date ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{typeRegister} = 3 THEN source.current_date ELSE NULL END )
mapper.update: UPDATE register SET employee_id = #{employee.id}, start_of_the_day = #{startOfTheDay}, entry = #{entry}, exit = #{exit}, break_time = #{breakTime}, back_to_work = #{backToWork}, day = #{day} WHERE id = #{id}
